title: Item set
description: A gear set with 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses on the five armor pieces of one family, or a 2-piece bonus on a ring pair (03-GAME-DESIGN §6.2; the table of 08-ITEMS.md §6). One file per set under content/sets/<id>.json; each piece is an ordinary item file whose setId points here and whose set line spends one affix slot. Membership survives promotion; the bonuses do not ride the ladder.

family.description: The armor family the pieces belong to, or 'ringPair' for a two-ring set.

theme.description: The zone or family it is themed on ('the Crypts, Gravehollow F4–6').

classIds.description: Classes the set is written for; empty means any class.

pieces.description: Item ids of the members: five armor pieces (helmet, chest, legs, boots, gloves) or two rings. The linter checks each exists, carries this setId and sits in the right slot.

bonuses.description: Effect lines by pieces worn. A ring pair has only '2'.

bonusText.description: The bonus lines as the card prints them.

gradeMin.description: The lowest grade the pieces drop at (08 §6 'Grades D–B': D).

gradeMax.description: The highest grade the pieces drop at; null when only the floor's shape bounds it.

dropChance.description: Share of gear rolls at grades that have sets which come up as a set piece (08 §10.1: 15).
